name: LIMERENCE
source:
A short story of a captive and a captor chatting over dinner. Not so much horror but more a tense, uneasy atmosphere and an imbalance of power. 

[Edited from [url=https://catsket.itch.io/limerence]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个俘虏和俘虏在晚餐时聊天的短篇故事。与其说是恐怖，不如说是一种紧张、不安的气氛和力量的不平衡。

[编辑自[url=https://catsket.itch.io/limerence]itch.io[/url]]
